issues.description: Point labels A-H and M are rendered in a regular-weight upright serif at a smaller size. In the original they are bold upright and noticeably larger (cap height roughly 18px versus roughly 14px in the render).
issues.suggestion: Set the label font to bold (e.g. \bfseries or \mathbf inside the node text) and increase the size to about \fontsize{14}{16}\selectfont, keeping the same node anchors so the vertex bindings are unchanged.
